name: Piggy Bank Hold&Win

features.name: Hold and Win
features.description: Collect coins in a respin bonus.

features.name: Jackpots
features.description: Mini 25x, Minor 50x and Major 125x, up to 2,500x overall.

review:
A cute, casual 3x3 with piggies and acorns. Collect coins and wake up the piggies to reach Hold and Win.

A blue mystery symbol can award the 25x Mini, 50x Minor or 125x Major at the end, and you can also win them by landing the matching coin. The big draw is pace: the bonus comes round about once every 30 spins. Medium volatility, 2,500x max and 96.98% RTP.
pros: Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 30 spins on average)
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
